answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a sunk, non-refundable fee to join, blocking mass forgery. Fees rise on a terrace: first 5 credits, second 10, third 20, so each fake climbs a steeper ridge. Minting 100 fakes costs ~25,000 credits; one fake earns under 50, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once, keep one identity's full yield, and part of the tax rebates to the long-lived honest, so honesty beats whispering up a crowd of fakes.
